description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Age Estimation (POST /v3/age-estimation/), the standalone API that estimates a person's age from one selfie and runs a passive liveness check in the same call. Use when implementing an age gate, checking whether someone looks over 18 or 21, detecting underage users, or adding low-friction age assurance. Returns the estimated age, a liveness score and an Approved/Declined status against configurable age and liveness thresholds. Also covers the AGE_ESTIMATION workflow feature, where borderline ages fall back to ID verification and per-country age limits apply.
